annotations.note: There are no letters between June 11 and Aug. 1, 1943. During those weeks LCI(L)-62 took part in the New Georgia landings (battle credit July 1 and 4, 1943), which Tom could not mention under censorship.
Headaches and fever were among the first signs of malaria, which was rife in the Solomons; Tom was hospitalized with malaria in 1945.
